transfer(address,uint256).details: Vault calls this to push ERC-20 tokens to the harvest recipient.      The layer token contract must grant MINTER_ROLE to this vault,      OR the vault must hold a pre-funded balance (pull model).      Phase 1: pre-funded balance (SafeERC20 transfer from vault reserve).      Phase 2: dedicated mint() role on layer token contracts.
